content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for National Institute of Homoeopathy Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for National Institute of Homoeopathy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor & Consultant posts at the National Institute of Homoeopathy is scheduled for 21 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor & Consultant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Assistant Professor and Consultant positions at the National Institute of Homoeopathy. This includes 1 for Assistant Professor (Case Taking and Repertory) and 2 for Assistant Professor (Practice of Medicine), and 1 for Consultant (Physiotherapist).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: For the Assistant Professor positions, candidates must possess a Graduation or Post-graduation degree in Homoeopathy. The specific specializations are Case Taking and Repertory, and Practice of Medicine.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Assistant Professor and Consultant roles?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Assistant Professor is 45 years, with relaxation up to 63 years for retired persons. For the Consultant (Physiotherapist) role, the maximum age limit is 64 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor and Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The selected Assistant Professors will receive a salary of Rs. 55,000/- per month. The Consultant (Physiotherapist) will be paid Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this National Institute of Homoeopathy recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor and Consultant posts at the National Institute of Homoeopathy will be based on an Interview. Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies. Passport-size photographs may also be required.

faq.question: Q9. Is the application process online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to apply online beforehand; they must report directly to the venue on the specified date.

faq.answer: The official notification for the National Institute of Homoeopathy Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly.
